text:
alex: Quick heads up — planning to flip tilt-3.2q (quant) into the catalog tomorrow 10:00am PST. Need merge-watch, smoke, pin + rollback owner. Who's around?

maria: I can merge and run basic smoke. PR 4892 is ready, waiting on one review.

sam: I'll own pin/rollback. Is slot-77 free? If not I can use slot-42.

infra-bot: slot-check: slot-77 available. Reply 'reserve slot-77' to claim.

sam: reserve slot-77 please.

infra-bot: slot-reserve: Slot 77 reserved for tilt-3.2q from 2024-05-02T17:00Z for 90m by sam.

jun: I'll do staging smoke + perf checks. Thresholds: p99 < 180ms, error rate < 1.5%. If p50 > 120ms fail.

leo: I'll monitor dashboards and toggle alerts. Paging policy: errors > 1% or latency +25% above baseline.

maria: Merge planned T-10m (09:50 PST). smoke script below:

```
# smoke loop
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood-inference/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
    -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
    -d '{"model":"tilt-3.2q","prompt":"smoke test","max_tokens":8}' &
done
wait
```

sam: Rollback plan (quick):
1) catalog.alias swap -> tilt-3.1x
2) helm rollback catalog-release 1
3) unpin slot and revert routing config
I'll add exact commands to the ops doc.

jun: I'll mark smoke FAIL if p50>150ms or p99>240ms or errors>2%.

leo: Adding temporary canary alerts and a cost watch (token-cost > +25% triggers slack alert).

canary-bot: canary: 5% traffic route applied to canary instances in us-west2 (2x A100). Monitoring started.

maria: MERGED PR 4892 -> main. Tagging tilt-3.2q@release-20240502

alex: Starting staging smoke now. Maria please pause further changes until we confirm.

jun: Smoke run 1 results: 60 reqs, 0.8% errors (most from a single host), p50 40ms, p95 95ms, p99 160ms. Marking green but will re-run after 10m.

sam: Pinning: catalog.pin('tilt-3.2q', slot=77, version='release-20240502') -> OK (pin-8821).

alex: Nice. Set canary at 5% for 60m. If stable, ramp to 25% for 2h, then 100% overnight.

maria: ACK. I'll kick off a small eval suite against the canary set every 15m (quality checks).

leo: Dashboards up. Auto-rollback enabled on latency > +30% or errors > 1.8%.

alex: Great work. I'll post a short rollout note and update the rollout doc after the 1h window.

jun: Watching logs and collecting traces.

infra-bot: log: pin operation logged id=pin-8821 by sam at 1745011802.

alex: Closing loop — thanks all, will follow up with a short retro if we see any regressions.
